threads.body: `TypeAlias` is only available from `typing` in Python 3.10+. If this package still supports Python 3.8/3.9 (common for OTel libs), this import will raise `ImportError` at import time. Prefer importing `TypeAlias` from `typing_extensions`, or use a compatibility import (try `typing` then fallback to `typing_extensions`), unless the package metadata has been bumped to require Python >= 3.10.
